articles.summary: Korea’s inclusion in the FTSE World Government Bond Index is creating a new phase of global investor engagement with Korean Treasury Bonds. As market reforms improve accessibility and settlement options, international investors are increasingly evaluating KTBs for benchmark exposure, diversification, collateral use and broader fixed income strategies. Tradeweb explores how electronic trading, transparent pricing and efficient workflows are helping global and domestic market participants access Korea’s bond market more effectively.
articles.title: Korea's WGBI Inclusion Is Driving a New Phase of Investor Engagement

articles.summary: Trading activity on the Tradeweb European-listed ETF marketplace reached EUR 84.3 billion in June and nearly EUR 240 billion in the second quarter of the year, the platform’s second highest quarterly volume on record. The proportion of transactions and notional volume completed via Tradeweb’s Automated Intelligent Execution (AiEX) tool amounted to 95% and 34%, respectively.
articles.title: Tradeweb Exchange-Traded Funds Update – June 2026

articles.summary: New York/London/Hong Kong/Singapore/Sydney, (July 15, 2026) ‒ The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), the premier post-trade market infrastructure for the global financial services industry, today announced that it successfully converted assets held at The Depository Trust Company (DTC) into tokens that were then used in real production trades, a notable milestone that marks the largest tokenization production initiative in breadth of use cases, asset classes and number of participants.
articles.title: DTCC Turns Tokenization into Reality: U.S. Trades Successfully Processed Using DTC-Tokenized Assets

articles.summary: I started my career on a corporate credit trading desk, and back then, market intelligence was something you built by hand, calling multiple counterparties, manually pulling data from a half-dozen systems and reading through stacks of research to piece together a view of where a bond should trade. Just as importantly, you built trusted relationships. The conversations you had with clients and counterparties provided context that data alone couldn't, and those relationships were often as valuable as the information itself.
articles.title: The AI-Powered Fixed Income Trader: Navigating the Future of Market Intelligence

articles.summary: NEW YORK – July 7, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported total trading volume for the month of June 2026 of $69.7 trillion (tn). Average daily volume ("ADV") for the month was $3.2tn, an increase of 29.5 percent (%) year-over-year ("YoY"). For the second quarter of 2026, total trading volume was $194.2tn and ADV was $3.0tn, an increase of 18.2% YoY, with preliminary average variable fees per million dollars of volume traded of $2.14 and total preliminary fixed fees for rates, credit, equities and money markets of $98.6 million (mm).
articles.title: Tradeweb Reports June 2026 Total Trading Volume of $69.7 Trillion and Average Daily Volume of $3.2 Trillion
